name: Calderford Central Zone Charging Ordinance

source_sentences: The registered keeper of each vehicle driven or parked in the zone on a weekday between 7:00 and 19:00 must pay $15 per vehicle per day, payable by midnight the next day.
Registered keepers whose registered address is in the zone receive a 90% discount, which makes the charge $1.50 a day.
The ordinance was adopted and published on 4 January 2027; charging starts on 1 November 2027 (ten months later).
It costs about $45 million a year to run and is funded from the gross revenue of the charge.

unclear.text: Whether a short delivery visit under thirty minutes is a chargeable day.
readings: U1-a: a short visit pays the daily charge
U1-b: a short visit is not a chargeable day

context: Just outside the zone lies Ringside, a band of about 1,100 shops and offices with three large parking garages, five to ten minutes' walk from the zone's edge (WE-046 record).
Peak load on bus routes into the zone is about 85% of capacity; new buses take 14 to 18 months from order to service (WE-046 record).
